Fuelwise – Cheap Petrol Prices Near You
Most drivers searching for cheap petrol near them don’t realise they’re overpaying.

Not because they don’t care.
Because they can’t see it happening.

Fuelwise changes that instantly.

You pull into a petrol station, fill up, and leave. What you don’t see is the cheaper fuel station just minutes away, the £4–£7 you just overpaid, or how often it’s been happening. Fuelwise makes it visible.

Find the cheapest petrol and diesel prices near you with live UK fuel price comparisons. Search any postcode, town or city and compare fuel stations by price, distance, and real value across major UK brands including Shell, BP, Esso, Tesco, Asda, Sainsbury’s and more.

See fuel prices your way. View nearby petrol stations on a live map or in a simple list, with clear red, amber, green ratings so you instantly know what’s cheap and what isn’t.

Planning a journey? Fuelwise finds the cheapest petrol station along your route — not just nearby. See detour time, real savings, and total fuel cost before you commit. This is where most drivers save the most.

Fuelwise also tells you something most fuel apps don’t: whether to fill up now or wait. By analysing UK petrol and diesel price trends, you get a clear signal — not a guess.

Add your car and everything becomes personalised. See accurate fuel costs, estimated range, and real journey fuel calculations based on your tank size and MPG.

Filter fuel stations by distance, brand, or fuel type. Compare petrol prices anywhere in the UK and always know where the cheapest fuel actually is.

Fuelwise highlights when you’re about to overpay — showing the exact difference between the cheapest and most expensive stations nearby and exactly how much you’d save by choosing smarter.

Most drivers overpay every week without realising it.

Fuelwise shows you exactly where, why, and how to stop.

Download Fuelwise — or keep paying extra and telling yourself it’s only a few pence.
